title: 中国粉面几大派①兰州牛肉面：一碗面，五种颜色都是规矩 | China Noodle Schools P1 · Lanzhou 🍜
description:
一碗兰州牛肉面，你先喝汤还是先嗦面？评论区说说。

【中国粉面几大派·第1集 兰州牛肉面】正宗的标准，全写在颜色里——一清：牛骨汤加十几味料熬到透亮；二白：萝卜片白如玉；三红：一勺红辣子油泼下去；四绿：香菜蒜苗撒满面；五黄：面条黄亮又筋道。更绝的是那块面团，师傅手里能拉出毛细、韭叶、大宽等十几种粗细，各人各的口感。这手拉面技艺，是国家级非物质文化遗产。记住一句话：汤清，才是一碗面真正的功夫。

A real bowl of Lanzhou beef noodles is written in five colors: one clear (a bone broth simmered with a dozen spices), two white (jade-pale radish), three red (a ladle of chili oil), four green (cilantro and garlic sprout), five yellow (bright, springy noodles). And from one lump of dough a master pulls a dozen widths — hair-fine, leaf, wide-belt. The pulling craft is a national intangible heritage. Remember: a clear broth is the real skill.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food culture, not dietary advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
